key.name: data-source
key.description: CGM data source (libreview, dexcom, or nightscout)

key.name: libreview-email
key.description: LibreView account email address

key.name: libreview-password
key.description: LibreView account password

key.name: libreview-patient-id
key.description: Selected patient/connection ID for multi-patient accounts

key.name: libreview-region
key.description: LibreView/LibreLinkUp region override (e.g., DE, EU, US, AP). Leave empty for automatic detection.

key.name: username
key.description: Dexcom Share account username

key.description: Dexcom Share account password

key.name: region
key.description: Dexcom Share server region (US or Non-US)

key.description: Upload LibreView readings to Dexcom Share

key.description: Dexcom Share username for uploading data

key.name: dexcom-upload-password
key.description: Dexcom Share password for uploading data

key.name: dexcom-upload-region
key.description: Dexcom Share region for uploading data

key.name: enable-dexcom-upload-2
key.description: Mirror Dexcom readings to a second Dexcom Share account (different region)

key.name: dexcom-upload-username-2
key.description: Dexcom Share username for mirror account

key.name: dexcom-upload-password-2
key.description: Dexcom Share password for mirror account

key.name: dexcom-upload-region-2
key.description: Dexcom Share region for mirror account (US or Non-US)

key.name: nightscout-url
key.description: Your Nightscout site URL (e.g., https://your-site.herokuapp.com)

key.name: nightscout-api-secret
key.description: Your Nightscout API secret (minimum 12 characters)

key.description: Disable SSL/TLS certificate validation for self-signed certificates (WARNING: Less secure)

key.description: Show glucose trend direction arrows

key.description: Show time since last reading

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Show or hide the icon in the panel

key.name: icon-position
key.description: Position of the icon relative to the text (left or right)

key.name: enable-debug-logs
key.description: Enable debug logging for troubleshooting
